name: typography-native-deps
notes: Not vendored in-tree. Resolved at configure time via pkg-config. Versions below are the locked development/reference set on the M1 Air Homebrew prefix; configure fails closed on missing or older packages.

dependencies.name: freetype
dependencies.reference_version_notes: pkg-config libtool version corresponding to FreeType 2.15.x
dependencies.role: font face load and glyph raster

dependencies.name: icu4c
dependencies.keg_only_hint: Homebrew icu4c is keg-only; add $(brew --prefix icu4c@79)/lib/pkgconfig to PKG_CONFIG_PATH
